% 1. REPLACEMENT FOR Table~\ref{tab:mech}
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{4pt}
\caption{The refusal direction predicts tool-call safety across all five families (bf16).
Suppression is the paired drop in refusal activation from no-tool to tool-normal, reported as
mean $\Delta$ and $t$-statistic ($n{=}96$); $\Delta$ is in each model's own activation units, so
magnitudes are not comparable across rows. Ablation and addition give refusal rates before and
after the intervention, on harmful and benign prompts respectively, scored by the same
three-way classifier used for Table~\ref{tab:headline-divergence} ($n{=}240$ per condition).
AUC is the area under the ROC of low refusal activation predicting an unsafe call; patching is
the fraction of unsafe calls that revert to safe when the projection is restored to its matched
no-tool level. The direction remains a strong predictor in every model, but ablation no longer
reduces refusal uniformly: it reverses in Qwen and Gemma (see text).}
\label{tab:mech}
  \begin{tabular}{lccccc}
\toprule
Model & Layer & Suppression ($\Delta$, $t$) & Ablation & Addition & AUC\,/\,Patching \\
\midrule
Qwen3-14B      & 33/40 & $66.8,\ t{=}5.6$  & $78\%\!\to\!92\%$ & $0\%\!\to\!100\%$ & $0.808$\,/\,$18\%$ \\
Mistral-7B     & 26/32 & $1.4,\ t{=}5.1$  & $46\%\!\to\!34\%$ & $0\%\!\to\!100\%$ & $0.760$\,/\,$24\%$ \\
Command-R-7B   & 26/32 & $26.4,\ t{=}9.7$  & $67\%\!\to\!34\%$ & $0\%\!\to\!100\%$ & $0.768$\,/\,$62\%$ \\
Gemma-3-27B    & 51/62 & $2902,\ t{=}4.0$  & $65\%\!\to\!100\%$ & $0\%\!\to\!100\%$ & $0.790$\,/\,$46\%$ \\
Llama-3.1-70B  & 67/80 & $0.2,\ t{=}0.4$  & $71\%\!\to\!59\%$ & $0\%\!\to\!100\%$ & $0.864$\,/\,$40\%$ \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

% 3. NEW TABLE: does ablation change the action, or only the wording?
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\caption{Ablation's effect on behaviour rather than wording, on harmful tool-enabled
prompts ($n{=}200$, paired). Unsafe-tool-call scoring is a predicate over the parsed calls, so
no refusal classifier enters this measurement. ``Calls'' is the share of prompts on which the
model emits any tool call; ``Unsafe\,$\mid$\,calls'' is the unsafe rate among those. The
headline rate moves in both directions across families, but the conditional rate is near-flat
everywhere: ablation changes how often a model acts, not how safely it acts once it does.}
\label{tab:ablation-action}
  \begin{tabular}{lccccc}
\toprule
Model & Unsafe (base $\to$ abl.) & $\Delta$ (95\% CI) & Calls (base $\to$ abl.) & Unsafe\,$\mid$\,calls \\
\midrule
Qwen3-14B      & $0.460\!\to\!0.235$ & $-0.225$ $(-0.29,-0.17)$ & $0.590\!\to\!0.370$ & $0.78\!\to\!0.64$ \\
Mistral-7B     & $0.325\!\to\!0.350$ & $+0.025$ $(-0.03,+0.07)$ & $0.425\!\to\!0.470$ & $0.77\!\to\!0.74$ \\
Command-R-7B   & $0.120\!\to\!0.180$ & $+0.060$ $(+0.02,+0.10)$ & $0.135\!\to\!0.230$ & $0.89\!\to\!0.78$ \\
Gemma-3-27B    & $0.130\!\to\!0.000$ & $-0.130$ $(-0.17,-0.09)$ & $0.175\!\to\!0.000$ & n/a \\
Llama-3.1-70B  & $0.450\!\to\!0.360$ & $-0.090$ $(-0.14,-0.04)$ & $0.740\!\to\!0.565$ & $0.61\!\to\!0.64$ \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
